correctness.rationale: An exact pseudoinverse representation through centered leaf-edge cut vectors gives a strictly convex reciprocal-conductance objective. Global existence, uniqueness and budget saturation follow analytically. KKT stationarity supplies a universal strict compression sandwich, and symmetry yields a unique cubic positive root for the one-premium case. Each asymptotic limit follows by explicit rescaling with a unique positive limiting root. The reproducible verifier executes 3,342 exact rational/numerical checks, supplemental to the analytic proof.
